next:wr:83.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:83.hint: 彼は彼女を助けるという約束をした
next:wr:83.answer: He made a promise to help her.
next:wr:83.fullSentence: He made a promise to help her.
next:wr:83.explanation: promiseのように動詞的意味を持つ抽象名詞は a promise to do の形をとり、a promise which to do のようにwhichは使わない。
next:wr:83.relatedInfo: a promise to doで『〜するという約束』。

next:wr:85.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:85.hint: 私たちの間にどんな秘密もあってはならない(秘密があることは不可能だ)
next:wr:85.answer: It is impossible for there to be any secrets between us.
next:wr:85.fullSentence: It is impossible for there to be any secrets between us.
next:wr:85.explanation: There is構文が不定詞になる場合、意味上の主語はfor there to beの形をとる。
next:wr:85.relatedInfo: 形式主語itを使った構文。

next:wr:87.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:87.hint: 会えて嬉しい(〜して…だ:感情の原因)
next:wr:87.answer: I am glad to see you.
next:wr:87.fullSentence: I am glad to see you.
next:wr:87.explanation: 感情形容詞+to do『〜して…だ』(感情の原因を表す不定詞の副詞的用法)。
next:wr:87.relatedInfo: sad, surprised, happyなども同じ形をとる。

next:wr:89.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:89.hint: 目が覚めて(その結果)自分が部屋に一人でいることに気づいた
next:wr:89.answer: He woke up to find himself alone in the room.
next:wr:89.fullSentence: He woke up to find himself alone in the room.
next:wr:89.explanation: wake (up) to find [see] ~『目が覚めて(その結果)〜だと気づく』。結果を表す不定詞の副詞的用法。
next:wr:89.relatedInfo: grow up to be, live to doなども同じ結果用法。

next:wr:91.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:91.hint: 彼女は100歳まで生きながらえた(生きた結果100歳になった)
next:wr:91.answer: She lived to be a hundred years old.
next:wr:91.fullSentence: She lived to be a hundred years old.
next:wr:91.explanation: live to do ~『〜するまで生きながらえる(生きた結果〜する)』。結果を表す不定詞の副詞的用法。
next:wr:91.relatedInfo: grow up to be, wake up to findも同グループ。

next:wr:93.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:93.hint: 彼は牛乳を買うために店に行った
next:wr:93.answer: He went to the store to buy some milk.
next:wr:93.fullSentence: He went to the store to buy some milk.
next:wr:93.explanation: 目的地移動動詞(go, come等)+to do『〜するために、〜する目的で』。不定詞の副詞的用法(目的)。
next:wr:93.relatedInfo: in order to doとほぼ同義。

next:wr:95.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:95.hint: 彼女の話し方を聞けば、あなたは彼女を日本人だと思うだろう
next:wr:95.answer: To hear her talk, you would take her for a Japanese.
next:wr:95.fullSentence: To hear her talk, you would take her for a Japanese.
next:wr:95.explanation: 文頭の独立不定詞『〜すれば、〜だとしたら』(条件を表す慣用的不定詞)。
next:wr:95.relatedInfo: 仮定法の帰結節(would)と共に使われることが多い。

next:wr:97.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:97.hint: 手伝ってくれるなんてあなたは親切だ
next:wr:97.answer: It is kind of you to help me.
next:wr:97.fullSentence: It is kind of you to help me.
next:wr:97.explanation: It is [of A] to do ~『Aが〜すること(は…だ)』。kindのように人の性質を表す形容詞のときはofを使う。
next:wr:97.relatedInfo: It is [for A] to do ~ が通常の形式主語構文。

next:wr:99.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:99.hint: 彼は私が着く前にその手紙を読んでしまったように思われた
next:wr:99.answer: He seemed to have read the letter before I arrived.
next:wr:99.fullSentence: He seemed to have read the letter before I arrived.
next:wr:99.explanation: 不定詞の時制: to+原形=述語動詞と同時、to have+過去分詞=述語動詞より前の時を表す。
next:wr:99.relatedInfo: He seems to be ill.(同時) との対比。

next:wr:101.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:101.hint: 彼はその時、病気であるように(その時)思われた
next:wr:101.answer: He seemed to be ill when I met him.
next:wr:101.fullSentence: He seemed to be ill when I met him.
next:wr:101.explanation: seemed to be『(その時)〜であるように(その時)思われた』。過去の時点と不定詞の時が同時。
next:wr:101.relatedInfo: seems to be(現在同士)との対比。

next:wr:103.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:103.hint: 彼はそれ以前病気だったように(その時)思われた
next:wr:103.answer: He seemed to have been ill before that.
next:wr:103.fullSentence: He seemed to have been ill before that.
next:wr:103.explanation: seemed(過去の判断)+to have been(それより前の状態)。
next:wr:103.relatedInfo: 不定詞の時制のズレを表す表現の総まとめの一つ。

next:wr:105.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:105.hint: 彼は友人に付き添われたいと思っている
next:wr:105.answer: He wants to be accompanied by his friends.
next:wr:105.fullSentence: He wants to be accompanied by his friends.
next:wr:105.explanation: to be V.pp『〜されること』。不定詞の受動態。
next:wr:105.relatedInfo: to be doing(進行)と対になる形。

next:wr:107.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:107.hint: 彼女はいつでも他人を助けたがる
next:wr:107.answer: She is eager to help others whenever she can.
next:wr:107.fullSentence: She is eager to help others whenever she can.
next:wr:107.explanation: eager, anxious, willing, ready, prepared to do『〜したがる』のグループ。
next:wr:107.relatedInfo: apt, inclined, prone to do『〜しがちだ』、able, qualified to do『〜する能力がある』も関連グループ。

next:wr:109.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:109.hint: この薬は飲みやすい(快い)
next:wr:109.answer: This medicine is pleasant to take; it doesn't taste bad at all.
next:wr:109.fullSentence: This medicine is pleasant to take; it doesn't taste bad at all.
next:wr:109.explanation: tough構文でよく使われる形容詞: easy(simple)⇔difficult(hard, tough, rough)、pleasant(comfortable)⇔unpleasant(uncomfortable)、safe⇔dangerous。
next:wr:109.relatedInfo: 人の主観的な難易・快さを表す形容詞群。

next:wr:111.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:111.hint: 彼女は投票するのに十分な年齢だ
next:wr:111.answer: She is old enough to vote.
next:wr:111.fullSentence: She is old enough to vote.
next:wr:111.explanation: 形容詞/副詞+enough+to do『…するのに十分〜だ』。
next:wr:111.relatedInfo: enoughは形容詞の後ろに置く点に注意。

next:wr:113.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:113.hint: 彼はパズルを解けるほど(十分)賢い
next:wr:113.answer: He is smart enough to solve the puzzle.
next:wr:113.fullSentence: He is smart enough to solve the puzzle.
next:wr:113.explanation: 形容詞+enough+to do『…するのに十分〜だ』の基本形。
next:wr:113.relatedInfo: He was not smart enough to solve the puzzle.(否定形)との対比。

next:wr:115.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:115.hint: 彼はパズルを解かないほど賢かった
next:wr:115.answer: He was smart enough not to solve the puzzle.
next:wr:115.fullSentence: He was smart enough not to solve the puzzle.
next:wr:115.explanation: enough not to do『〜しないほど…だ』。
next:wr:115.relatedInfo: notの位置に注意(enoughの後、toの前)。

next:wr:117.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:117.hint: 彼は成功するほど一生懸命働いた
next:wr:117.answer: He worked hard so as to succeed.
next:wr:117.fullSentence: He worked hard so as to succeed.
next:wr:117.explanation: so ~ as to do『〜するほど…だ、とても…なので〜する』。
next:wr:117.relatedInfo: so as to do は「〜するために」の意味でも使われる(目的)。

next:wr:119.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:119.hint: 彼は試験に合格するために一生懸命勉強した(目的)
next:wr:119.answer: He studied hard so as to pass the exam.
next:wr:119.fullSentence: He studied hard so as to pass the exam.
next:wr:119.explanation: so as to do ＝ in order to do『〜するために(目的)』。
next:wr:119.relatedInfo: 否定形はso as not to doとなる。

next:wr:121.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:121.hint: 実を言うと、私は彼が好きではない
next:wr:121.answer: To tell you the truth, I don't like him.
next:wr:121.fullSentence: To tell you the truth, I don't like him.
next:wr:121.explanation: to tell (you) the truth『実を言うと』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:wr:121.relatedInfo: 文頭で本音を切り出すときに使う。

next:wr:123.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:123.hint: まず第一に、自己紹介をしましょう
next:wr:123.answer: To begin with, let's introduce ourselves.
next:wr:123.fullSentence: To begin with, let's introduce ourselves.
next:wr:123.explanation: to begin (start) with『まず第一に、手始めに』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:wr:123.relatedInfo: 文頭に置いて話の順序を示す。

next:wr:125.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:125.hint: 彼を公平に判断すれば、彼は勤勉な人だ
next:wr:125.answer: To do him justice, he is a hard worker.
next:wr:125.fullSentence: To do him justice, he is a hard worker.
next:wr:125.explanation: to do A justice『Aを公平に判断すれば』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:wr:125.relatedInfo: 欠点を挙げた後にフォローする文脈でよく使う。

next:wr:127.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:127.hint: 彼は母語は言うまでもなく、3つの言語を話す
next:wr:127.answer: He speaks three languages, to say nothing of his native one.
next:wr:127.fullSentence: He speaks three languages, to say nothing of his native one.
next:wr:127.explanation: to say nothing of A『Aは言うまでもなく』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:wr:127.relatedInfo: not to mention Aともほぼ同義。

next:wr:129.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:129.hint: 言うまでもなく、彼はその結果に失望した
next:wr:129.answer: Needless to say, he was disappointed with the result.
next:wr:129.fullSentence: Needless to say, he was disappointed with the result.
next:wr:129.explanation: needless to say, ~『言うまでもなく〜だ』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:wr:129.relatedInfo: 文頭に置くのが一般的。

next:wr:131.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:wr:131.hint: 奇妙な話だが、その見知らぬ2人は兄弟だとわかった
next:wr:131.answer: Strange to say, the two strangers turned out to be brothers.
next:wr:131.fullSentence: Strange to say, the two strangers turned out to be brothers.
next:wr:131.explanation: strange to say『奇妙な話だが』。独立不定詞の慣用表現。
next:wr:131.relatedInfo: 文頭に置いて意外な事実を導入する。
